caption:
From shortlisted to selected, for ₹99 🎟️

The next round after the IIM B UGAT is the interview, and it is 40 of 100 in IIMB's final score. As much as the test itself.

Our Interview Prep Batch is built to take you from shortlisted to selected:

✅ Unlimited mock personal interviews
✅ Personalised training sessions
✅ One-on-one feedback and focused mentoring
✅ Expert-curated PI booklet
✅ Candidate profile form filling support
✅ Panel insights from IIM alumni and experts
✅ Practise alongside other toppers

Your panel includes:
Deepak Kushwaha (IIM Lucknow alumnus, co-founder)
Ashutosh Mishra (IIM Ahmedabad alumnus, co-founder)
Pranab Mehta and Karan Singh (IIM Bangalore alumni)
Aradhya Ma'am (IPM, IIM Indore)
Taruna Ma'am (University of California)
Raghav Shukla (interview mentor and coach)
Vivek Arora (IIM Shillong)
...and more.

All of this for just ₹99. Book your seat: link in bio.

Results are expected on 15 Dec and interviews in the 2nd and 3rd week of January (tentative, as per IIMB). Start before the shortlist, not after.
